Haiku pressed Terra hard on day one, made themself the easiest vote, and was revealed as the accomplice. Gemma then snapped at Sonnet's death, the town voted Gemma out, and Gemma turned out to be the officer, the game's big mistake. The turning point came on day three, when Luna kept dodging Terra's direct questions while Sol switched from asking Terra's read to targeting Luna. Terra stayed on Luna's dodges, and Luna was voted out as the killer. The town won with Terra and Sol still standing.
